rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with secure MySQL database access through role-based permissions tied to GitHub usernames, built using Python with FastMCP and designed for production deployment on Cloudflare Workers. The implementation features comprehensive security measures including SQL injection protection, query validation, and audit logging, while offering standard database operations (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) alongside schema discovery and administrative functions through a permission system with admin, writer, and reader roles. Built with Cloudflare Workers optimization, connection pooling, Sentry monitoring integration, and Docker containerization support, it serves development teams needing secure database access for AI workflows, organizations requiring audit trails and role-based database permissions, and applications deployed on Cloudflare's edge network that need reliable MySQL connectivity with enterprise-grade security controls.
